messages:
maria: Heads-up: we saw a morning spike from the payments integration, invocations returning TOOL_SCHEMA_MISMATCH. Affected ~1.8% of invocations for a heavy tenant.
aj: Any links to traces or a sample payload? What did the adapter log show?
maria: Pasted an anonymized example:
```
{
  \"error_type\": \"tool_schema_mismatch\",
  \"tool\": \"payments_v2\",
  \"expected\": \"{order_id:int,amount:float}\",
  \"received\": \"{\"order_id\":\"abc123\",\"amount\":null}\",
  \"request_id\": \"req_1a2b\"
}
```
lorenzo: Looks like string-for-int (order_id) plus null amount. Do we know if the adapter rejected before invoking the tool or the tool executed and errored?
aj: Adapter currently fails fast (strict). It rejects on schema mismatch to avoid running side-effecting tools with bad inputs.
sahil: Two policy questions: 1) should we bill for calls that fail schema validation? 2) what alerting/console UX do we want for noisy mismatches?
deb: From product: we prefer not to bill customers for clear validation rejections. But customers must be able to discover and fix these quickly in Console.
maria: Draft policy: don't bill per-token usage for invocations rejected pre-execution. Instead increment a separate metric rejected_invokes. Show a clear Console flag with guidance.
lorenzo: Separate metric SGTM. For oncall, page SRE if tenant-level rate >5% OR absolute >500/min sustained for 5 minutes.
ops-bot: action: create metric alert: metric=\"invokes.rejected.tool_schema_mismatch\" aggregation=rate(1m) group_by=tenant thresholds: absolute>500 or pct(tenant,5min)>0.05 -> page.
aj: Telemetry: include labels expected_shape, received_shape, tool_name, and coarse error_bucket (coercion/null/missing_field).
sahil: Sampling plan: include full payloads for 1% of mismatches; hashed signatures for the rest. Also capture route_id, model_variant, and canary/strict flags.
deb: Console UX: per-route row with rejected_invokes, sample_examples link, and quick-fix suggestions (e.g., allow nullable amount or cast order_id). Add a \"suppress for tenant\" toggle for support staff.
maria: Rollout plan: ship metrics + Console indicator to canary clusters (5%) with soft-notify only, no paging. Monitor 48h, then enable tenant-level paging and billing behavior.
lorenzo: On-call playbook: triage steps -> check adapter logs -> look at sample payloads -> contact tenant engineering.
aj: Implementation detail: adapter should return explicit soft vs hard error codes. soft = rejected pre-exec, hard = executed but returned wrong shape.
sahil: Billing mapping: only bill on hard. soft increments rejected_invokes metric and surfaces in Console.
maria: Edge-case: partial tool responses where some fields are wrong types. Those should be hard if the tool executed. Need reliable indicator from adapter.
deb: Can we add a trace tag: tool_exec=skipped|executed? Product wants Console suggestions to depend on that tag.
aj: Yep. We'll add trace.setTag(\"tool_exec\",\"skipped\") in the early rejection path and include it in telemetry. Small code example:
```
// adapter
if (!schemaMatches(payload)) {
  emitMetric(\"invokes.rejected.tool_schema_mismatch\", {tool, tenant})
  trace.setTag(\"tool_exec\", \"skipped\")
  return {error: \"TOOL_SCHEMA_MISMATCH:soft\"}
}
```
ops-bot: Ticket INF-3241 created: \"Tool schema mismatch policy + telemetry + alerts\" assigned to @aj.
maria: Next steps: aj implements metric + trace tag + soft/hard codes; lorenzo drafts alert thresholds; deb mocks Console row; sahil designs sampling knobs.
lorenzo: Ping me when PR lands; I'll run alert sim locally.
deb: For customer-facing wording, keep it non-technical: \"We rejected a tool call due to an unexpected response shape\" with a \"View example\" link.
sahil: Timeline: canary next week, full rollout two weeks after if clean.
aj: I'll open a PR tomorrow with unit tests and a small staging run.
maria: Thanks all. Looping in @oncall for final confirmation on paging thresholds once drafts are ready. Closing thread; follow-ups tracked in INF-3241.
